real.title: What is real
real.real_heading: What is real in this demo
real.real_body: The screens, payment trail, status-code explanations, and next-step design are real.
real.simulated_body: The case, government records, payment status, and offices are offline sample data. No government system is contacted.
real.no_ai_heading: Why no AI writes our answers
real.no_ai_body: Each answer comes from a checked rule and a written content catalogue. This makes the reason, action, and owner clear to audit.
real.next_body: Voice in regional languages through Bhashini, and in-browser face authentication through WebRTC instead of forcing an app download.
cause.b5.fto_rejected: The bank could not accept this payment instruction.
action.b5.visit_bank: Visit your bank branch and ask them to check your PM-KISAN payment account.
cause.b2.aadhaar_not_seeded: Your Aadhaar is not linked to the account used for this payment.
action.b2.seed_aadhaar: Visit your bank branch with Aadhaar and ask them to link it to your account.
cause.b3.ekyc_pending: Your PM-KISAN e-KYC is not complete.
action.b3.complete_ekyc: Complete e-KYC at a Common Service Center.
cause.b3.ekyc_otp_unavailable: Your e-KYC needs an OTP, but the Aadhaar-linked mobile number cannot receive it.
action.b3.visit_csc: Visit a Common Service Center with your Aadhaar card for e-KYC help.
cause.b4.land_mismatch: Your land record does not match the scheme record.
action.b4.correct_land: Ask your land records office to check and correct the record.
cause.b5.account_inactive: The bank account for this payment is inactive.
action.b5.activate_account: Visit your bank branch and ask them to activate the account.
cause.b5.npci_unmapped: Your bank account is not mapped for Aadhaar payments.
cause.b6.itd_excluded: The record shows an income-tax exclusion.
action.b6.review_exclusion: Ask the income-tax office to review this exclusion.
